text: くっ……　つよいと　おもったら　それは　サカキさまの　バッジ……！

structure.jp: つよいと　おもったら
structure.en: I thought you were strong, and sure enough

structure.jp: それは　サカキさまの　バッジ……！

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら here means 'when I did this, I found that'. With とおもう it gives the feeling 'no wonder'. つよいと　おもったら = 'I thought you were strong, and now I see why'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: つよいと　おもったら
patterns.explanation: と before おもう shows what the thought was. つよいと　おもった = 'I thought (you were) strong'.
